_comment: No Figma component — flagged 2026-08-19 as central to the 24-hour reservation flow in the PRD despite one call site. Built from the Frontend per the amended authority rule (2026-08-20). A HH:MM:SS badge fed by a countdown to `expiredAt`.

_unmigrated_type._note: The floated badge uses the Frontend's `text-label-xs` = 8/14 Semibold, and the sidebar variant `text-label-l` = 14/24. Neither pair exists as a role in the type system, same situation as header-bar-mobile's four legacy styles — literals until Phase 2 grows a role.
_unmigrated_type.label-l: 14/24 — sidebar variant; falls back to body.lg.medium (16/24) until a role exists, recorded so the 2px difference is a known gap rather than a silent one

_source.height: `h-6` = 24, on the non-floated shape only; the floated badge hugs its text.
_source.radius: rounded-full on the pill; the floated badge is `rounded-t-md` (6px, top corners) on mobile.
_source.colors: default: white badge, brand-red text. red variant: primary background, on-bgcolor text. sidebar: background.light.
_source.float-position: Frontend positions the floated badge absolute top-10 inside `notification`'s relative wrapper — that offset belongs to the parent, so the component only ships position:absolute and leaves the inset to the caller.

_frontend_evidence.component: lotteryplus-frontend-main/src/components/common/notification/timer — plus the `notification` wrapper whose only job is relative positioning for the floated badge

_verified_from.scope: token mirror searched for timer/countdown; frontend timer + notification + use-countdown read in full
_verified_from.result: VERIFIED ABSENT in Figma. Frontend is the authority per the amended rule (user decision 2026-08-20).
